comp2.title: Research infrastructure for observation and experimentation:
comp2.description: The GNSS Research Lab combines multi-frequency receivers, geodetic antennas, specialised stations, processing software and computing resources to support education, field experimentation and advanced research.

comp3.title: GNSS Receivers and Antennas
comp3.description: The laboratory supports multi-constellation and multi-frequency observations through research-grade and cost-effective GNSS receivers.

comp4.title: Software and Processing Platforms
comp4.description: Dedicated platforms support simulation, post-processing, real-time positioning and data analysis

cards.title: Custom tools for PPP, RTK, CORS
Custom tools for signal processing and visualization

comp5.title: ICTP GNSS Station
comp5.description: The ICTP GNSS station supports continuous observation of navigation signals and contributes to research in ionospheric variability and space weather. The station strengthens international scientific cooperation and enables the lab to connect local observations with broader research networks.

comp6.title: GISTM Receiver
comp6.description: The PolaRx5 GISTM receiver provides multi-frequency GNSS observations for ionospheric and scintillation studies.

cards.title: Effects of space weather on navigation performance

comp7.title: Academic CORS Network
comp7.description: The Academic and Research GNSS CORS Network is designed to support high-precision positioning, geodetic research, training and practical applications in the Islamabad region.

comp8.title: Student Research Workstations
comp8.description: High-performance workstations provide students and researchers with dedicated resources for simulation, GNSS data processing, algorithm development, geospatial analysis and visualization. Shared storage and software environments support reproducible research and supervised laboratory work.
